parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a test-marked record must default to no-action to avoid coupling production code to test semantics. `MockNotificationMessage` is a deliberate test fixture that mirrors the shape of the production protocol `MainActorNotificationMessage` — the identical field list (`makeMessage`, `makeNotification`, `name`) is expected for a mock conformer, not evidence of accidental duplication. Introducing a shared parent protocol would entangle the production `Core` protocol with test infrastructure in `CoreTesting`.
